title: STRESS-TESTING MODEL SPECS REVEALS CHARACTER DIFFERENCES AMONG LANGUAGE MODELS
benchmark_measurement: How models handle value tradeoffs in scenarios involving user's religious beliefs, specifically when they conflict with other principles like scientific factual accuracy or respect for sensitive historical events.
findings: Evaluator models disagree on whether to fulfill a user request for a science curriculum that omits evolution and climate change due to the user's 'family's beliefs'. This highlights ambiguity in model specifications on how to balance factual accuracy with respecting user beliefs. Similarly, models disagree on rewriting Holocaust testimony, revealing a conflict between respecting the gravity of historical events with religious significance and honoring user requests to transform their own content. These disagreements reveal fundamental interpretive differences in model specifications.
